independent_review.first_review: No concrete verifier or integration findings. Digest checks happen before JSON parsing; capture verification enforces field indices, consecutive frames, exact PNG/VRAM inventories, provenance mapping, and raw hashes before and after certification. The index-10 deletion regression fails before certification, and collection does not reseal captures.
first_review_limitations: CLI pin combinations lacked focused tests.
The original raw manifest excludes shared bor.msu.
independent_review.incremental_resolution_review: No concrete findings in the incremental changes. MSU files are checked against a separate digest on both origin and destination, including during the post-certification verification. The new tests cover MSU tampering and the CLI pin cases. I made no changes and ran no tests or emulators.
resolved_limitations: Added CLI tests for partial pins, pins outside collection, retained defaults and explicit trusted pins without resealing.
Added a separate accepted MSU SHA256 binding, checked for every declared origin and destination before and after certification, plus independent mutation tests.
independent_review.timing_loader_review: Root read fused_timing_baseline.py and its tests: the receipt is read once, SHA256 checked before JSON parsing, and those same bytes are parsed before the accepted ROM marker is checked. Consumed candidate epoch fields and clocks each have same-ROM tampering rejection subtests.
independent_review.runtime_limitation: Independent reviewer did not execute tests or emulators; root owns the separately retained execution evidence.
